Title: Event hubs on Azure Stack Hub is now generally available

Body.Content:
Event Hubs is a reliable and scalable event streaming engine that backs thousands of applications across every kind of industry in Microsoft Azure. We are now announcing the general availability of Event Hubs on Azure Stack Hub. Event Event Hubs on Azure Stack Hub will allow you to realize cloud and on-premises scenarios that use streaming architectures.

Learn more.    

Read the Event Hubs documentation.
